processDefinition.name: account_eod_settlement
processDefinition.description: 账户日终清算DAG：汇总account_transaction流水，更新account_balance日终余额快照，并记录账户状态变更日志

taskDefinitionList.name: extract_account_transaction
taskDefinitionList.description: 抽取当日account_transaction流水到临时表tmp_eod_flow

taskParams.sql: INSERT INTO ${db_finance}.tmp_eod_flow PARTITION (p_${biz_date}) SELECT account_id, transaction_id, direction, amount, currency, posted_at FROM ${db_finance}.account_transaction WHERE posted_at >= '${biz_date} 00:00:00' AND posted_at < '${biz_date} 23:59:59';

INSERT INTO ${db_finance}.tmp_eod_delta PARTITION (p_${biz_date}) SELECT account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'DEBIT' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS debit_sum, SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'CREDIT' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS credit_sum, SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'CREDIT' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS net_amount, '${biz_date}' AS settle_date FROM ${db_finance}.tmp_eod_flow GROUP BY account_id;

taskDefinitionList.name: update_account_balance
taskDefinitionList.description: 更新account_balance日终余额快照：上日余额+当日净额=当日余额

taskParams.sql: INSERT INTO ${db_finance}.account_balance (account_id, balance, available_balance, frozen_amount, currency, snapshot_date, snapshot_type, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) SELECT a.account_id, COALESCE(prev.balance, 0) + d.net_amount AS balance, COALESCE(prev.available_balance, 0) + d.net_amount AS available_balance, COALESCE(prev.frozen_amount, 0) AS frozen_amount, a.currency, d.settle_date, 'EOD', NOW(), NOW(), 'dag_account_eod_settlement', 'dag_account_eod_settlement' FROM ${db_finance}.tmp_eod_delta d JOIN ${db_finance}.account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, balance, available_balance, frozen_amount FROM ${db_finance}.account_balance WHERE snapshot_date = DATE_SUB('${biz_date}', INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND snapshot_type = 'EOD') prev ON d.account_id = prev.account_id;

taskDefinitionList.name: check_account_status
taskDefinitionList.description: 检查账户状态变更：余额为0/负数/超额等触发状态变更，写入account_status_log

taskParams.sql: INSERT INTO ${db_finance}.account_status_log (account_id, old_status, new_status, change_reason, changed_at, operator, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) SELECT b.account_id, a.status, CASE WHEN b.balance = 0 THEN 'ZERO_BALANCE' WHEN b.balance < 0 THEN 'OVERDRAWN' ELSE a.status END AS new_status, CASE WHEN b.balance = 0 THEN '余额归零' WHEN b.balance < 0 THEN '透支' ELSE '正常' END AS change_reason, NOW(), 'dag_account_eod_settlement', NOW(), NOW(), 'dag_account_eod_settlement', 'dag_account_eod_settlement' FROM ${db_finance}.account_balance b JOIN ${db_finance}.account a ON b.account_id = a.account_id WHERE b.snapshot_date = '${biz_date}' AND b.snapshot_type = 'EOD' AND (b.balance = 0 OR b.balance < 0);

taskDefinitionList.name: reconcile_eod_report
taskDefinitionList.description: 生成日终清算对账报告：总借贷平衡校验

taskParams.sql: SELECT '${biz_date}' AS settle_date, SUM(debit_sum) AS total_debit, SUM(credit_sum) AS total_credit, SUM(debit_sum) - SUM(credit_sum) AS balance_diff, CASE WHEN ABS(SUM(debit_sum) - SUM(credit_sum)) < 0.01 THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS reconcile_result FROM ${db_finance}.tmp_eod_delta;

emailConfig.subject: [DAG]account_eod_settlement完成通知-${biz_date}
emailConfig.content: 账户日终清算已完成，业务日期：${biz_date}，请关注account_balance与account_status_log表数据。
